output_list.code: function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {        _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);        return true;    }
output_list.reason: In this function, the transfer function is called by anyone. The function does not include any randomness or pseudo-randomness. The function will always transfer the exact amount of tokens specified by the user. This could be exploited to transfer tokens to an unauthorized address. The attacker can control the _to parameter and transfer tokens to any address they want. This could be used for malicious purposes like token whaling, token theft, or token speculation.
